references.title: DWDS: anders
references.supports: Adverb with the Grundform ander and no Wortzerlegung

notes.rationale: Kann es anders sein? DWDS derives the adverb from the pronoun ander (its Grundform) with the adverbial -s; an affixal derivation takes Constituents, not a Source (ADR 0050). The adverbial -s is on no closed affix list yet. The pronoun ander is no authored member, so the part links to its Unit Shadow, pending.
